verdict.rationale: LangSmith's core product is tracing LLM applications. It instruments calls via SDK wrappers such as wrap_openai, environment variables, framework integrations, or OpenTelemetry. Token usage and latency appear as first-class metrics in dashboards and alerts, and hands-on users confirm inspecting the inputs and outputs of each step. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing per-trace capture of inputs, outputs, latency and token fields (inputs/outputs are evidenced only by community reports; latency and token usage only as aggregate dashboard and alert metrics).

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture traces of my LLM calls with inputs, outputs, latency, and token usage

citations.quote: Add tracing to your app in minutes with environment variables, framework integrations, or the SDK.
Prebuilt dashboards are created automatically for each project and cover essential metrics, such as trace count, error rates, token usage, and more.
LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency
The power of LangSmith is seeing full traces moving through the graph and being able to inspect the inputs and outputs for each step
